purpose: Express surprise that a normally reliable person made an error.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
Of all people, I went and forgot my key.
Careful as he is, he skipped the check.
Even our teacher got the date and time wrong.
restrictions: Often self-directed with 私 or 僕.
mistake: The following act should conflict with normal expectations of that person.
